patient give this the room that it actually wants so just drawing that ascending trend line and looking if we actually do end up trading down below it if you want my full like portfolio management for thumbnail so look out for that maybe turn on your notifications so you don't end up missing this post whenever i do make it either way moving on to the bitcoin etf flow tables yesterday we saw huge net inflow once again guys we are on a crazy streak of inflows here massive inflows too of hundreds of millions of dollars flowing in every single day into these bitcoin etfs so obviously this is
